import json,importlib.util
from src.tools import pbs_mixed_accounting as mixed
root=Path.cwd().resolve()
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('existing_original_submit',root/'scripts/pbs/submit_phase.py')

rows=[('gpu_pack_test_priority_single_01','709485.hopper-m-02'),('gpu_pack_test_priority_single_02','709489.hopper-m-02')]
canonical=submit._final_accounting(root,{j for n,j in rows},paths=[root/'results/diag_gpu_pack_test_priority_singles_0102_accounting_01.json'])
for name,job in rows:
 report=json.loads((root/'results'/(name+'_mixed_accounting.json')).read_text())
 actual=mixed.finalized_split(root,{'name':name,'payload':report['config']['payload_reference']['file'],'job_id':job},canonical[job])
 assert actual is not None
 print('ORIGINAL_FINALIZED_SPLIT_ACCEPTED: '+json.dumps({'name':name,'job_id':job,'charged_gpu_hours_by_group':actual['charged_gpu_hours_by_group'],'total_charged_gpu_hours':actual['total_charged_gpu_hours']}),flush=True)
